lines.text: Paul says God did not reject His people, and he is an Israelite from the tribe of Judah.
Paul recalls that Elijah appealed to God against Israel, saying they had killed the prophets and torn down the altars.
God replied that He had reserved seven thousand men who had not bowed the knee to Baal.
Paul says a remnant is chosen by grace, and if it is by grace, it is no longer by works.
Israel failed to obtain what it sought, but the priests did, and the others were hardened.
